Enum Condition

pub enum Condition {
    Format1AxisRange(ConditionFormat1),
    Format2VariableValue(ConditionFormat2),
    Format3And(ConditionFormat3),
    Format4Or(ConditionFormat4),
    Format5Negate(ConditionFormat5),
}
Expand description

Condition Table

Formats 2..5 are implementations of specification changes currently under debate at ISO for an OFF update. For the time being the specification is https://github.com/harfbuzz/boring-expansion-spec/blob/main/ConditionTree.md.
